## Description

Doctor taps or hotword to ask (e.g. "last eGFR"); answers shown as text first and spoken only through a connected private earpiece ("whisper mode"); if the earpiece disconnects, the assistant turns off; answers come only from the patient's verified chart with source.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The assistant never speaks through the room speaker; disconnecting the earpiece disables it immediately (test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Every answer cites its chart source; no diagnosis or treatment advice.
- [ ] **AC3.** Queries and answers are audited without storing audio beyond policy.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
